scope:
Two exact raw-envelope dual obstructions on the fixed Report632 STAR/source.

The first envelope requires one thinning uniformly over all pair central phases.
The second fixes Report632's pair central phases before choosing the thinning.
Both keep raw product responses and every original coefficient/menu. These are
method-envelope obstructions, not covering examples or arithmetic nonexistence.
Standard-library exact arithmetic; no optimizer or Lean verification is claimed.

free_dual.all_nonnegative_thinnings: gate <= -margin * sum_c w_l*v_m*theta_c; strictly negative for nonzero theta

fixed_dual.all_nonnegative_thinnings: gate <= -margin * sum_c w_l*v_m*theta_c; strictly negative for nonzero theta
